terminal_process_receipt: Original controller observed rc0 and retained return; consumed from original run
scope: Analytical review of the supplied design only; reviewer explicitly ran no code and accessed no data
useful_limits: Identity-permuted graphs test peer identity, not the direction of transmission. A transpose/reversed-direction control would be needed before any strong leadership interpretation.
Shared omitted exposures or clustered mean reversion can give real-neighbor forecasts an advantage without causal propagation.
Annual graph refresh can miss within-year relationship changes; trailing residual betas change the definition of innovations.
Matched early-alert precision and conditional lead are descriptive without their own dependence-aware comparison; graph-return ranking is not calibrated pivot timing.
Four fixed placebo graphs are a sensitivity check, not an exact randomization test.
principal_corrections: Using peer information observed at t to predict a target future at t+h is a lagged prediction. The claim that same-date peer features cannot distinguish selected incoming from outgoing peers is too strong: transposing scores can change peer membership and predictions. Causality nevertheless remains unproven.

The frozen implementation ce5b1a25c explicitly applies Holm4 to IC-gain p-values before result inspection. Rank-MSE and precision are additional prespecified gates, not opportunistically selected p-value metrics.
Train-only standardization and clipping were explicit in the protocol and implemented before tests. The reviewer scaling concern is not a discovered code defect.

The first counterexample incorrectly says all five selected peers receive0.2 weights. The actual method uses proportional positive scores; scores .31,.27,.22,.18,.11 normalize by1.09, not equal weighting.
Descriptive precision4/4 is not arithmetically wrong because observations are dependent; independence matters for uncertainty/generalization, which is not established by that count.
Reconstructed data do not establish original live availability, but this does not erase the validity of a carefully qualified retrospective comparison.
followup_before_any_causal_claim: Direction-reversal and factor/sector-preserving control design, separately fixed and judged only under permitted future research; no additional run launched to recover the blocked output
